_note: Variable (tuning) capacitor, air or film dielectric, panel mount with a knob. 2-terminal: a (stator), b (rotor/frame). Engine (bw-board tuning_cap): a knob control like the potentiometer, position 0..1 sets the capacitance from minFarads to maxFarads. The panel part has only these two electrical leads; outer leads at the potentiometer's pitch so it seats like one.
